title: Evaluate Brave Answers endpoint for native-style grounded answers
description: Evaluate and possibly implement the Brave Answers endpoint (OpenAI-compatible, token-metered: ~$4 per 1K requests + $5 per 1M tokens per AIMultiple May 2026 — verify against brave.com/search/api current docs first) as an opt-in, disabled-by-default native-style answer capability. Prerequisite: verify the official API surface and pricing before any scoping. Open questions: (1) billing — token-metered answers must sit behind their own explicit opt-in gate, NOT covered by the existing BRAVE_API_KEY free-mode admission that gates search; (2) credential var — same key or separate subscription key; (3) routing position — Brave's search role is conservative last-resort keyword path (DESIGN.md), so answers likely need a different position (explicit-hint only). Same user rationale as pi-search-06j6: agent-side synthesis covers current workflows, so this stays opt-in, not default.

logs.msg: Created from 2026-09-06 provider round: user declined implementation now, wants the option tracked. Do not start without explicit user direction; verify current API surface against official Brave docs first.

Declined 2026-09-06: same rationale as 06j6 — Brave Answers is token-metered answer synthesis that the agent itself performs better from evidence. Brave's role stays the conservative free-mode evidence path. Task closed as declined.
Reopened same day: prior 'declined' close was too absolute. Correct position: opt-in capability behind its own gate, never under the free-mode Brave search admission.

Shipped together with 06j6 in 49b7ccb: brave-answers implemented behind PI_SEARCH_ENABLE_BRAVE_ANSWERS=1, billing separate from free-mode search admission; research mode deliberately not exposed (agent's web_research covers multi-step depth). Live contract smoke pending user opt-in.
